text:
leah_partnerships: Quick sync  partners want firm marketplace freeze dates for B200 + H200. We need lab signoffs and SI windows before we lock metadata. Any blockers?

tom_infra: B200 power derate test showed a 7% perf hit under our default thermal profile. We're re-running with revised fan curve. H200 BIOS still pending vendor patch. MI300 nightly is flaky on 32k contexts (OOMs in a specific quant path).

nina_si: SI schedule is tight next week. We can do connector validation Tue/Thu mornings but need firmware/ABI and kernel packages by Mon EOD. If we don't get them, we'll only certify H100/B200 compatibility baseline and hold H200/MI300/Gaudi for a follow-up cert.

ash_vendor_pm: On the H200 BIOS, engineering pushed a candidate this morning; shipping formal build tomorrow. For B200, partner engineering suggests a recommended power profile (attached doc). For Gaudi, theres a driver diff vs our distro; they're packaging a backport.

leah_partnerships: Good. Action items: (1) Tom to run fan-curve rerun + new image for B200, (2) Nina to reserve SI slots Tue/Thu, (3) Ash to confirm timestamped artifact drop by Mon. Also: avoid customer-facing embargo until SI certs are green.

tom_infra: Running reruns Tue 06:30-09:00 UTC. I'll push image tag gaudi-k6-backport-2024 and b200-fancurve-v2. Logs to follow.

deploy-bot: image gaudi-k6-backport-2024 pushed to staging at 2024-04-08T06:45:00Z. Smoke tests queued.

nina_si: Reserved Tue 07:00 UTC. If artifacts miss the window well run a partial cert for H100/B200 and flag H200/MI300/Gaudi as "pending" on marketplace. That keeps listings accurate.

ash_vendor_pm: Confirmed: H200 BIOS build will be uploaded to partner bucket by 2024-04-07T18:00:00Z. MI300 team will push a nightly with a debug flag to trace long-context OOMs.

leah_partnerships: OK. Draft marketplace blurb (internal): "Initial GA: H100, B200 (certified). H200, MI300, and Gaudi: pending final vendor artifacts; expected follow-on validation within 1 week of cert.

Please keep this thread as the single source for artifacts and timestamps. Paste S3 links, firmware hashes, and any embargo constraints here. :spiral_calendar:
